_source: Bench-only configuration for the nine bare A6-EC motors on bench-servo (no gearboxes attached). Owner direction 2026-09-14: drive-internal rotation-mode gear ratio 1/1 on every drive, software ratio 1, so one motor revolution is one output revolution (131072 counts). Derived from config/bench-ninemotor-a6ec.json (identities, signs, slave positions, bus bring-up); motion limits are bench placeholders for bare motors, unverified until measured. Not a robot configuration; authorises no motion by itself. Profile a6ec_bench_1to1 (2026-09-14): identical to a6ec except the coordinate-evidence physical speed bound, which the 131072-count anchor period requires below half a turn per mailbox acquisition; see the profile note.
max_motor_rpm_unverified: unverified: bare-motor bench cap; 10 rev/min = 1.0472 rad/s at ratio 1; measure stopping under the bench brake wiring before raising
